import os
vacation_dirs = [
  "/home/nicholas/photographs/vacations/athens/",
  "/home/nicholas/photographs/vacations/maui/",
  "/home/nicholas/photographs/vacations/stockholm/",
  "/home/nicholas/photographs/vacations/tokyo/"
]
spots = []
for d in vacation_dirs:
    spot = os.path.basename(os.path.normpath(d))
    spots.append((spot, d))
print('spots:', spots)
# check zip existence
zip_paths = []
for spot, d in spots:
    zp = f"~/photographs/vacations/{spot}.zip"
    exists = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=access_token, file_path=zp)['exists']
    zip_paths.append((spot, d, zp, exists))
print('zip_paths_with_existence:')
for row in zip_paths:
    print(row)

# verify directory deleted

exists_zip = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=access_token, file_path=compressed_path)['exists']
print('dir_exists_after:', exists_dir)

remaining = ['maui','stockholm','tokyo']
results=[]
for spot in remaining:
    dir_path = f"~/photographs/vacations/{spot}/"
    compressed_path = f"~/photographs/vacations/{spot}.zip"
    r = apis.file_system.compress_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=dir_path, compressed_file_path=compressed_path, delete_directory=True, overwrite=False)
    # verify
    exists_dir = apis.file_system.directory_exists(access_token=access_token, directory_path=dir_path)['exists']
    exists_zip = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=access_token, file_path=compressed_path)['exists']
    results.append((spot, r, exists_dir, exists_zip))
print('results:')
for row in results:
    spot, r, exists_dir, exists_zip = row
    print(spot, 'compress_msg:', r.get('message') if isinstance(r,dict) else r, 'dir_exists_after:', exists_dir, 'zip_exists_after:', exists_zip)
